audience: training and education teams who issue digital badges and certificates with Accredible

useCases.title: Search credentials issued to a recipient
useCases.text: The AI searches credentials with filters, such as a recipient e-mail, and shows group, issue date, expiry and published state. It can open one credential in full.

useCases.title: Check views and shares of credentials
useCases.text: The AI reads analytics events for one credential or for the whole account in a date range, such as views, shares and downloads.

useCases.title: List the groups and designs for issuing
useCases.text: The AI searches groups (courses or qualifications) and badge and certificate designs, and reads one group with its outcomes and design ids.

useCases.title: Check remaining credits and the issuer account
useCases.text: The AI reads the issuer behind the key with its name and remaining credential credits, so you know how many you can still issue.

useCases.title: Prepare a draft credential for one recipient
useCases.text: The AI creates one credential in an existing group. It is unpublished by default, so no e-mail is sent until you publish it in the Dashboard.
